items.source:
Also called the inner product, calculates the negated dot product of two
vectors.
items.translation: 也称为内积，计算两个向量的点积的负值。

items.source: Also called L2_DISTANCE, calculates the Euclidean distance between two vectors.
items.translation: 也称为 L2_DISTANCE，用于计算两个向量之间的欧几里得距离。

items.source:
Also called L2_SQUARED is the Euclidean distance without taking the square
root.
items.translation: 也称为 L2_SQUARED，即未开平方的欧几里得距离。

items.source: Also called L1_DISTANCE or taxicab distance, calculates the Manhattan distance.
items.translation: 也称为 L1_DISTANCE 或出租车距离，用于计算曼哈顿距离。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source: Default metric. It calculates the cosine distance between two vectors.
items.translation: 默认度量。它计算两个向量之间的余弦距离。

items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果此枚举类没有指定名称的常量，则抛出此异常。
